english.title: Import / export goods with intent to evade prohibition / restriction
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was knowingly concerned in

(A)_[carrying]_
(B)_[removing]_
(C)_[depositing]_
(D)_[harbouring]_
(E)_[keeping]_
(F)_[concealing]_
(G)_[dealing with]_

certain goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF THE GOODS..), with respect to the

(H)_[exportation]_
(I)_[importation]_

of which a prohibition or restriction was for the time being in force with intent to evade any such prohibition or restriction with respect to the goods
english.legislation: Contrary to section 170(1)(b) and (3) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See offence wordings H3642, H3621, H3622, H3623, H3624, H3625, H3626, H3627 and section 170(4) of and Schedule 1 to this Act for details of modifications to the penalties under under section 3 of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971.
(ii) See offence wording H3645 and section 170(4A) for modifications to the penalties under sections 20 and 21 of the Forgery and Counterfeiting Act 1981.
(iii) See offence wording H3648 and section 170(4)(B) for modifications to the penalties under regulation 2 of the Seal Skins Regulations 1986.
(iv) See section 171 for general provisions as to offences and penalties.
(v) See section 49 for forfeiture provisions

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine of £20,000 or of three times the value of the goods, whichever is the greater.
INDICTMENT: Seven years imprisonment and / or a fine.
